# Solar Review — Meta video ad scripts

Six scripts, each 20–30 seconds (about 55–70 spoken words). Swap `[MARKET]` for the place name (Los Angeles, Orange County, the Inland Empire, San Diego, Salt Lake). Every script ends on the same single next step: **book a free evaluation at fixmy.energy/book**.

## Rules every script follows (do not edit these out)
- No prices, savings amounts, incentive or rebate amounts, percentages, guarantees, or time limits.
- No claim of a partnership with any manufacturer (SolarEdge, Enphase, Tesla, SunPower and so on).
- Never talk down the old installer. Say what happened, not who was bad.
- Never promise a result. We check the system and tell them what we find.
- Evaluation is free, no obligation, and the homeowner needs to be there for the visit.
- No "local" claim outside San Diego. Say "our team" instead.
- Keep it plain. No emojis in the spoken text.

## Direction for the avatar / editor
- Vertical 9:16. The first 2 seconds carry the hook as big on-screen text, because most people watch muted.
- Calm, warm, direct, like a neighbor who knows solar. No shouting, no hard-sell music.
- Burned-in captions on every line. End card: "Free evaluation — fixmy.energy/book".
- B-roll that is real: a roof with panels, an inverter with a blank or error display, a utility bill, a technician checking a panel box. Avoid stock-photo handshakes.

## Script 1 — "Is your installer still in business?" (hook: the closure)
**On-screen hook (0–2s):** IS YOUR SOLAR INSTALLER STILL IN BUSINESS?
**Spoken:**
"If your solar company in [MARKET] shut down, your panels are still on the roof, but your warranty may have nobody left to call. Inverters, monitoring, a claim you can't file. We work on solar systems whatever company installed them. Book a free evaluation, and we'll check your system and tell you what we find. No obligation."
**On-screen text:** Installer closed? · Any brand · Free evaluation
**CTA:** Book now at fixmy.energy/book
**Headline (≤40):** Installer closed? We still help
**Description (≤30):** Free solar evaluation
**Primary text:** If your solar installer closed, your system still needs someone to look after it. We check any system, any brand. Book a free evaluation.

## Script 2 — "Your inverter went quiet" (hook: the symptom)
**On-screen hook:** NO LIGHTS ON YOUR INVERTER?
**Spoken:**
"A blank screen or a red light on your inverter usually means your system isn't producing, even on a sunny day in [MARKET]. Many homeowners don't notice for months. Our technician checks the inverter, the panels and the connections and explains what's wrong in plain words. The evaluation is free."
**On-screen text:** Blank screen · Error light · Not producing
**CTA:** Book a free evaluation — fixmy.energy/book
**Headline:** Inverter not working?
**Description:** Free evaluation
**Primary text:** A dead display or an error light is easy to miss. We'll find out what's going on, any brand, and explain it simply. Free, no obligation.

## Script 3 — "Check your bill" (hook: the bill doesn't match)
**On-screen hook:** BILL STILL HIGH WITH SOLAR?
**Spoken:**
"You put solar on your roof in [MARKET] so your bill would drop. If it's still high, or it jumps at the end of the year, something may be off with the system, or with how it's set up for your utility. Upload a bill or book a visit and we'll look at your real numbers. The evaluation is free."
**On-screen text:** Bill still high? · We check your real numbers
**CTA:** fixmy.energy/book
**Headline:** Solar bill still high?
**Description:** Free system check
**Primary text:** If your bill didn't drop the way you expected, let's find out why. We look at your system and your actual bill. Free evaluation.

## Script 4 — "Who do I call?" (hook: no one answers)
**On-screen hook:** WHO DO YOU CALL WHEN SOLAR STOPS?
**Spoken:**
"When the company that sold you solar is gone, there's a gap: nobody to check it, nobody to file a warranty claim, nobody to explain your monitoring app. We fill that gap for homeowners in [MARKET]. Book a free evaluation, and we'll look at the system and tell you where it stands."
**On-screen text:** No installer? · No problem · Free evaluation
**CTA:** fixmy.energy/book
**Headline:** Solar orphan? Start here
**Description:** Free evaluation, no obligation
**Primary text:** No installer to call? We look after solar systems whoever put them in. Start with a free evaluation.

## Script 5 — "Know your battery options" (hook: outages) — use only where the viewer already has solar
**On-screen hook:** POWER OUT. SOLAR OFF. WHY?
**Spoken:**
"Many solar systems shut off when the grid goes down, even in full sun. It's a safety rule, not a defect. If your system doesn't keep your lights on, a battery may be an option, but only after someone checks your system. We start with a free evaluation of what you have. No pressure and no obligation."
**On-screen text:** Grid down = solar off · Free evaluation first
**CTA:** fixmy.energy/book
**Headline:** Solar off in an outage?
**Description:** Free evaluation first
**Primary text:** Most solar stops when the grid does. Before anyone talks about a battery, we check what you have. Free evaluation, no obligation.
*Note: never name a battery price or any incentive in this ad.*

## Script 6 — "What happens at the visit" (hook: remove the fear)
**On-screen hook:** WHAT HAPPENS AT A FREE EVALUATION?
**Spoken:**
"Here's what to expect. You book a time that works. Someone from our team looks at your inverter, your panels and your utility bill, and takes a few photos. You need to be home. Then we tell you what we found, in plain words. There's no fee to book and no obligation after. Book yours today."
**On-screen text:** Pick a time · We check the system · You decide
**CTA:** fixmy.energy/book
**Headline:** Free solar evaluation, step by step
**Description:** No obligation
**Primary text:** Not sure what a solar evaluation involves? It's simple: pick a time, we check your system, you decide what's next. Free.

## Market notes (use in captions, not as claims of being local)
- **Los Angeles / Orange / Riverside / San Bernardino:** many homes are on Southern California Edison. "Net billing" is the current utility structure for newer systems; do not quote credits or rates.
- **San Diego:** SDG&E territory; the team is San Diego-based, so "San Diego" is fine to say as our home market.
- **Salt Lake:** Rocky Mountain Power. There is no California-style time-of-use pitch here; keep Script 5 and any battery language careful and general.
- **All markets:** the evaluation can be a technician visit, and in some areas a guided video evaluation. Don't promise either one in the ad; say "free evaluation."

## Checks before you publish
1. Read each spoken line once and confirm it contains no number with a $ or % sign.
2. The destination is `fixmy.energy/book`, and the tracking tags are added by the portal.
3. If a platform asks for a disclaimer, use: "Results vary. Evaluation is free with no obligation."
